sanjay: Heads up — we're seeing elevated 5xx/503 errors for embeddings in eu-west starting ~2026-03-23T09:45Z. Initial triage points to I/O saturation on the embed-store cluster impacting batched emb endpoint. Investigating now. status: investigating — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1809991111

michelle: Thanks. CS: pinging top impacted customers and compiling request IDs. I'll drop list shortly. @anna-cs can you coordinate on outreach? :phone:

anna-cs: On it. I have the top 6 customers who hit >10% error rate, contacting them now and offering workaround (reduce batch_size to 32).

eli: Root cause appears to be a concurrent large reindex job (internal backfill) + an unexpected surge of user bulk embed jobs. Embed-store IOPS spiked to limits and some reader pods timed out. I've started a rolling restart on replica set embed-store-eu-2 to free stuck file descriptors.

ops-bot: Alert log snippet:
```
2026-03-23T09:46:12Z ERROR embed-store io_timeout reader.go:142 id=embed-store-eu-2 req=xyz123 downstream=503
2026-03-23T09:46:13Z WARN  storage iops=9800/10000 burst=0 reindex_job=backfill-2026-03-22
```

sanjay: Mitigations applied so far:
- throttled internal reindex backfill (reduced parallelism from 40 -> 6)
- enabled read-replica routing for low-latency critical customers
- scaled embed-store pods in eu-west +30% (auto-scaling hit limits, did manual bump)
- rolled restart of 2/4 embed-store pods (one still queued)
Observed effect: error rate down from ~18% -> ~7% in last 10m for affected endpoints. Monitoring closely.

eli: Next steps I'm executing now:
1) complete final rolling restart of remaining embed-store pods (ETA ~12m)
2) warm up prefix cache by replaying small sample traffic to cold replicas
3) keep reindex throttled until IOPS stable at <70%
If restarts don't drop errors under 2%, we'll failover read traffic to eu-central replicas.

michelle: CS note: listed customers have been offered immediate temporary routing to eu-central. Some accepted. Recording case numbers and contacts.

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: suspended scheduled non-critical deploys to prod in eu-west for next 60m to minimize churn.

sanjay: Current patient status: partial customer impact (embeddings), mitigations reducing errors, ETA to clear for most customers ~30-45m unless regressions. Set incident severity to Sev2 for now.

anna-cs: Slack DM channel for customer updates: #cs-embeds-eu (created). Adding CSMs and account owners.

eli: Will post another update after final rolling restart completes or earlier if we see regression.

sanjay: For runbook and postmortem owners: please claim postmortem in #postmortems and attach timeline + mitigation decisions. Assign me as lead.

ops-bot: Incident bridge: https://call.redwood.ai/bridge/1809991111 (join for live ops).

michelle: Thanks team. I'll prepare a short status note for execs if we stabilize in next 30m. :white_check_mark:
